summary: A U.S. Senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, while advocacy organizations are highlighting recent federal interventions in the District—including a National Guard deployment and a federal takeover—as evidence of why local control matters. These developments underscore ongoing efforts to make D.C.'s lack of autonomy a focus for lawmakers and the public. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
One Year After President Trump Deployed National Guard Troops to Washington, D.C., Statehood is More Important Than Ever
